ifYouStop.title: If you stop
ifYouStop.paying: your running ads keep running on Meta, and your results and enquiries stay here. We'll remind you on Home when a payment is due. Nothing is deleted.
ifYouStop.disconnect: your ads keep running in Meta until you pause them there. AdBrain can't pause them or update results after that.
ifYouStop.delete: use Privacy and data requests below. Your campaigns stay in your own Meta ad account.

disconnect.title: Disconnect Facebook?
disconnect.body: Your ads keep running in Meta until you pause them there. After this, AdBrain can't pause them or update their results.

pilotDay7.question: One question after your first week: would you pay ₹999 a month to keep using AdBrain?

pauseAll.title: Pause all your ads?
pauseAll.body: {n} running campaigns will pause in Meta. Nothing is deleted, and nothing more will be spent once Meta stops them (usually within minutes). You can turn each one back on from Campaigns.
pauseAll.done: All {n} campaigns are paused. Nothing more will be spent.
pauseAll.partial: {k} of {n} paused. {names} didn't pause; tap Try again, or pause {f, plural, one {it} other {them}} in Meta Ads Manager.
